tasks.title: Fix chat topic mismatch: prevent job/candidate help responses for non-job conversation starts
tasks.last_error: QA_FAILED: deployed https://dev2.sima.adlr.ir/api/v2/chat/completions still returns job/candidate help for greetings. No topic_slug → 'سلام! چه کمکی از شما می‌خواهید؟ ... تا ابزار مناسب را انتخاب کنم.'; topic_slug=health → '...جستجوی یک شغل خاص، پیدا کردن یک نامزد مناسب...'; topic_slug=recruitment → '...دنبال یک شغل یا موقعیت کاری هستید؟ یا دنبال یک نامزد (کاندید)...'. Root cause: (1) TASK-108 code (resolveEffectiveTopic/enforceTopicPersistence/initial_topic intentBelongsToTopic, commits 229cca5+d3ed0cb) is present locally in /home/hamid/sima-dev but NOT deployed to dev2; (2) complete()/completeWithTools() reference $traceId before assignment (Undefined variable $traceId) — unauthenticated non-streaming path broken. Local unit tests pass (8/13 assertions) but cannot detect missing deployment. Fix: deploy bugfix/post-release-2.0.0 and hoist $traceId = generateTraceId() in complete() and completeWithTools().
tasks.summary: When a user starts a chat about health/safety or any topic other than recruitment/jobs and says hello, the bot incorrectly replies with job-search/candidate-finding help. Intent detection must respect the conversation's initial topic and not default to employment domain responses.

tasks.title: Enforce conversation topic persistence: prevent mid-chat topic changes by user
tasks.summary: A user must not be able to change the topic in the middle of an existing chat. Topic switching mid-conversation causes blocking after issue resolution. The chat must enforce topic persistence within a single conversation thread.

tasks.title: Fix Chinese language rendering/encoding issue in chat responses
tasks.summary: Chat responses exhibit a Chinese language/encoding problem (garbled or incorrect script). Responses must render in the user's language (Persian/English) without script substitution or mojibake.
